title: The Tithe of Experience
subtitle: An xp task in points, and one in whole levels
description: Experience is never taken automatically — the Submit press is the consent, and the press takes it — so both tasks here are manual. The first counts thirty points; the second counts five whole levels, because `points: false` reads the field as levels rather than points.
A quest with two xp tasks needs both presses. The line from the hub is `dash: dashed`, one of the six patterns the axis can take.
